"A machine to color fabrics and vases. Requires a jar of dye in one input, and the item in another output. An item will not be processed unless dye is present."

Description

This machine requires the items listed below in order to function:

  • Dyes - This will change the color of the items you insert

Items able to be dyed:

  • Glass - This will turn into Stained Glass.
  • Fabric Rolls
  • Vases
  • Bricks
  • Universal Stud
  • Candle (every size)
  • Candle holder (including the fancy version)
  • Backpacks

Trivia

  • Until 2026, the jars were not given back when the "Remove Dye Contents" button was pressed
